subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` ingest arbitrary JSONL message logs, or should raw-log search remain a QMD/session-memory/converter-plugin workflow?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding general JSONL ingestion changes sensitive memory exposure and overlaps with the specialized sanitized session-transcript parser.

options.title: Keep JSONL outside builtin
options.body: Document the supported QMD/session-memory or converter-plugin workflow and leave builtin extraPaths limited to Markdown plus approved multimodal files.

options.title: Approve scoped builtin JSONL
options.body: Add a narrow builtin parser for explicit extraPaths JSONL files with sanitization, line mapping, `memory_get` support, watcher coverage, docs, and tests.

recommendation.title: Keep JSONL outside builtin
recommendation.body: Document the supported QMD/session-memory or converter-plugin workflow and leave builtin extraPaths limited to Markdown plus approved multimodal files.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from the issue discussion and current blame for the relevant memory-host files.
